zh: 开始吧。
en: Let's get started.
alt: Shall we get started?
Let's kick off.
point: ‘开始吧’ 没主语，要补 let's：Let's get started

zh: 搞定了。
en: That's all sorted.
alt: It's all done.
That's done and dusted.
point: ‘搞定了’ 要补主语 that's/it's，不能只说 Finish

zh: 又连不上Wi-Fi了。
en: I can't connect to the Wi-Fi again.
alt: The Wi-Fi won't connect again.
point: 没主语，英文要补 I：I can't connect to …

zh: 又卡死了。
en: It's frozen again.
alt: It's hung again.
It's stuck again.
point: ‘卡死了’ 要补 it，用 It's frozen

zh: 吃饱了，谢谢。
en: I'm full, thanks.
alt: I'm stuffed, thanks.
I couldn't eat another bite.
point: ‘吃饱了’ 要补 I'm：I'm full，不说 Eat full

zh: 可以点菜了。
en: We're ready to order.
alt: We'd like to order now.
point: ‘可以点菜了’ 要补 we，用 ready to order

zh: 开始了！
en: It's kicked off!
alt: The game's started!
They've kicked off!
point: ‘开始了’ 要补 it，用完成时 It's kicked off

zh: 跑不动了。
en: I can't run any more.
alt: I can't run any further.
point: ‘跑不动了’ 补 I，用 can't … any more

zh: 有点贵了。
en: It's a bit pricey.
alt: That's a bit dear.
It's a bit expensive.
point: 形容词前要补 it's：It's a bit pricey

zh: 随便看看，谢谢。
en: I'm just looking, thanks.
alt: I'm just browsing, thanks.
point: ‘随便看看’ 要补 I'm：I'm just looking

zh: 到了吗？
en: Are we there yet?
alt: Have we arrived?
point: ‘到了吗’ 要说 Are we there yet，不说 Arrive?

zh: 赶不上飞机了。
en: We're going to miss our flight.
alt: We won't make our flight.
point: ‘赶不上’ 要补 we，用 miss / won't make

zh: 好多了。
en: I'm feeling much better.
alt: I feel a lot better.
point: ‘好多了’ 要补 I'm feeling，不说 Much good

zh: 这儿疼。
en: It hurts here.
alt: It's sore here.
I've got a pain here.
point: ‘这儿疼’ 要补 it：It hurts here

zh: 又下雨了。
en: It's raining again.
alt: It's pouring again.
point: 天气句要用 it 作主语：It's raining

zh: 吃饭了，快来！
en: Dinner's ready, come and get it!
alt: Dinner's on the table, come and eat!
point: ‘吃饭了’ 不是 Eat rice，要说 Dinner's ready

zh: 改天吧。
en: Let's do it another time.
alt: Maybe another time.
Can we make it another day?
point: ‘改天吧’ 要说 Let's … another time

zh: 该走了。
en: I'd better get going.
alt: I should head off.
Time for me to go.
point: ‘该走了’ 要补 I，常说 I'd better get going

zh: 不用找了。
en: Keep the change.
alt: You can keep the change.
point: ‘不用找了’ 说 Keep the change，不说 Don't need find

zh: 可以付现金吗？
en: Can I pay in cash?
alt: Do you take cash?
Is cash OK?
point: ‘可以…吗’ 要补 I：Can I pay in cash?

zh: 下周一再说吧，今天太忙了。
en: Let's talk about it next Monday, I'm flat out today.
alt: Can we deal with it on Monday? I'm too busy today.
point: 两个分句都没主语，要补 let's 和 I'm

zh: 来不及了，能不能延到周五？
en: We won't make the deadline. Can we push it back to Friday?
alt: We're not going to get it done in time — could we move it to Friday?
point: ‘来不及’ 要补 we，用 won't make it / the deadline

zh: 装好了，重启一下就能用了。
en: It's installed. Just restart and you're good to go.
alt: It's all installed — once you restart, it'll work.
point: ‘装好了’ 要补 it's，‘就能用了’ 补 you

zh: 报错了，不知道怎么回事。
en: It's throwing an error and I've got no idea why.
alt: I'm getting an error and I don't know what's going on.
point: ‘报错了’ 要补 it/I，用 throw / get an error

zh: 吃不完了，能打包吗？
en: I can't finish this. Could I get it to take away?
alt: I can't eat any more — can I get a box for this?
point: ‘吃不完’ 要补 I；打包说 take away / a box

zh: 订了位，七点，四个人。
en: We've got a booking for four at seven.
alt: We booked a table for four at 7.
point: 省略句要补 we，用 have a booking for

zh: 输了，不过踢得其实还不错。
en: We lost, but we actually played pretty well.
alt: We didn't win, but it was a decent game.
point: 两个分句都要补 we，不能只说 Lost, but played well

zh: 刚跑了五公里，累死了。
en: I've just done a 5k run and I'm knackered.
alt: I just ran five kilometres and I'm exhausted.
point: 两个分句都要补 I；‘累死了’ 说 knackered

zh: 能试一下吗？没有合适的尺码就算了。
en: Can I try it on? If you don't have my size, never mind.
alt: Could I try this on? If there's nothing in my size, don't worry about it.
point: ‘试一下’ 补 I + try on；‘就算了’ 说 never mind

zh: 不好意思，卖完了，下周才到货。
en: Sorry, we've sold out, but we're getting more in next week.
alt: Sorry, they're all gone — new stock arrives next week.
point: ‘卖完了’ 要补 we've sold out；到货 = get more in

zh: 快到了，再过十分钟左右。
en: We're nearly there, just another ten minutes or so.
alt: We're almost there — about ten more minutes.
point: ‘快到了’ 要补 we're：We're nearly there

zh: 堵车了，可能要晚半个小时。
en: I'm stuck in traffic, so I'll probably be half an hour late.
alt: There's heaps of traffic, I might be about 30 minutes late.
point: ‘堵车了’ 用 I'm stuck in traffic，‘要晚’ 补 I'll

zh: 感冒了，今天在家休息。
en: I've caught a cold, so I'm resting at home today.
alt: I've got a cold, so I'm staying home today.
point: ‘感冒了’ 要补 I：I've got a cold，不是 Cold

zh: 扭到脚了，走路一瘸一拐的。
en: I've twisted my ankle and I'm limping a bit.
alt: I rolled my ankle, so I'm hobbling around.
point: ‘扭到脚了’ 补 I've，脚踝用 ankle 不用 foot

zh: 停电了，冰箱里的东西要坏了。
en: There's a power cut and the food in the fridge is going to go off.
alt: The power's out, and the stuff in the fridge will go bad.
point: ‘停电了’ 说 There's a power cut / The power's out

zh: 周五该交房租了，别忘了。
en: The rent's due on Friday, so don't forget.
alt: Don't forget the rent needs paying on Friday.
point: ‘该交房租了’ 要说 the rent's due

zh: 好久没见了，最近怎么样？
en: It's been ages! How have you been lately?
alt: Long time no see — how's it going?
point: ‘好久没见’ 补 it's been ages；‘最近怎么样’ 用完成时

zh: 到家了吗？到了给我发个消息。
en: Are you home yet? Text me when you get there.
alt: Have you got home? Send me a message once you're back.
point: ‘到家了吗’ 要补 you；‘到了’ 用 when you get there

zh: 扣了两次钱，能帮我查一下吗？
en: I've been charged twice. Could you look into it for me?
alt: It's taken the money out twice — can you check it for me?
point: ‘扣了两次钱’ 要补主语，说 I've been charged twice

zh: 退款到了吗？说是三到五个工作日。
en: Has the refund come through yet? They said three to five working days.
alt: Have you got the refund yet? It's supposed to take 3–5 business days.
point: ‘到了吗’ 说 has it come through；‘说是’ 补 they said

zh: 收到，今天下班前改好发给你，有问题再说。
en: Got it, I'll make the changes and send it over before the end of the day. Let me know if anything comes up.
alt: Will do — I'll have it updated and back to you by end of day. Give me a shout if there are any issues.
point: ‘改好发给你’ 全省主语，要补 I'll 和 let me know

zh: 开会说了半天，最后也没定下来，只能下周再讨论了。
en: We went round in circles for ages and didn't decide anything, so we'll have to pick it up again next week.
alt: The meeting dragged on but nothing got decided, so we'll revisit it next week.
point: 整句无主语，要补 we；‘说了半天’ 用 go round in circles

zh: 已经回滚了，暂时恢复了，不过根本原因还没找到。
en: We've rolled it back and it's working again for now, but we still haven't found the root cause.
alt: It's been rolled back and things are up again for the moment, but we haven't pinned down the root cause yet.
point: 三个分句都缺主语，要补 we/it；‘还没找到’ 用 haven't … yet

zh: 部署到一半就挂了，看了日志，好像是权限的问题。
en: The deployment fell over halfway through. I've checked the logs and it looks like a permissions issue.
alt: It died halfway through the deploy — from the logs, it seems to be a permissions problem.
point: ‘挂了’ 补主语 + fell over；‘好像是’ 用 it looks like

zh: 等了快一个小时了，问了两次，还是说马上就好。
en: We've been waiting nearly an hour for our food, and we've asked twice, but they keep saying it's on its way.
alt: It's been almost an hour and still no food — we've chased it up twice and they just keep saying it's coming.
point: 整句省主语，要补 we；‘等了快一小时’ 用完成进行时

zh: 吃得差不多了，买单吧，今天我请，上次是你付的。
en: We're about done, so let's get the bill. It's my shout today, you paid last time.
alt: Shall we get the bill? This one's on me — you got it last time.
point: 全句省主语；‘我请’ 说 it's my shout / it's on me

zh: 看了上半场觉得没戏了，就关了电视，结果最后十分钟连得两个达阵。
en: I watched the first half, thought it was all over and switched off, then they scored two tries in the last ten minutes.
alt: I gave up at half-time and turned the TV off, and of course they got two tries in the last ten minutes.
point: 中文一路省主语，英文每个分句都要补 I / they

zh: 报名了半马，还有两个月，得开始认真练了。
en: I've signed up for a half marathon in two months, so I really need to start training properly.
alt: I've entered a half marathon and it's only two months away, so it's time to get serious about training.
point: ‘报名了’ 补 I，用 sign up for；‘得…了’ 说 need to

zh: 网上买的，到了才发现尺寸不对，能退吗？
en: I bought it online, but when it arrived it was the wrong size. Can I return it?
alt: I ordered this online and it turned out to be the wrong size — could I get a refund?
point: 每个分句都补主语 I/it；‘到了才发现’ 用 when it arrived

zh: 看了好几家，还是 Warehouse 最便宜，就在那儿买了。
en: I looked around a few shops and The Warehouse was the cheapest, so I ended up buying it there.
alt: After shopping around, The Warehouse had the best price, so that's where I got it.
point: ‘看了好几家’ 补 I，用 shop around；‘就在那儿买了’ 用 ended up

zh: 落地了，在等行李，估计还要半个小时才能出来。
en: We've just landed and I'm waiting for my bag, so it'll probably be another half hour before I'm out.
alt: I've just touched down — still waiting on my luggage, so I reckon another 30 minutes.
point: ‘落地了 / 在等行李’ 都要补主语 we've / I'm

zh: 出发前查一下天气，听说南岛这几天可能下雪。
en: Check the weather before we head off — apparently it might snow in the South Island this week.
alt: Have a look at the forecast before we leave; I heard it could snow down south over the next few days.
point: ‘可能下雪’ 补 it：it might snow；‘出发前’ 补 we

zh: 最近老是睡不好，早上起来头疼，是不是该去看看医生了？
en: I haven't been sleeping well lately and I keep waking up with a headache. Do you think I should see a GP?
alt: I've been sleeping badly and getting headaches in the mornings — maybe it's time I saw a doctor?
point: 补 I，用完成进行时；‘看医生’ 说 see a GP

zh: 约了下午三点看牙，可能要晚点到，手上的事还没弄完。
en: I've got a dentist appointment at three, but I might be a bit late — I'm still finishing something off.
alt: My dentist appointment's at 3, but I'm running a bit behind because I haven't wrapped up what I'm doing.
point: 三个分句都省主语；‘还没弄完’ 用 still finishing off

zh: 水龙头又漏水了，跟房东说了好几次，一直没人来修。
en: The tap's leaking again. I've told the landlord several times, but no one's come to fix it.
alt: The tap's dripping again — I've mentioned it to the landlord a few times and nobody's sorted it.
point: ‘说了好几次’ 补 I've；‘没人来修’ 用 no one's come

zh: 搬进来才发现没有暖气，冬天估计会很冷。
en: We only realised after moving in that there's no heating, so it's going to be freezing in winter.
alt: It wasn't until we moved in that we found out there's no heater — winter's going to be cold.
point: 补 we；‘会很冷’ 天气要用 it's going to be

zh: 本来想去的，临时有事去不了了，下次一定！
en: I was really keen to come, but something's come up and I can't make it. Next time for sure!
alt: I'd planned to come, but something came up last minute so I'll have to give it a miss — definitely next time!
point: ‘去不了’ 用 can't make it；‘临时有事’ 说 something's come up

zh: 聊得挺开心的，不知不觉就十二点了，该回去了。
en: We were having such a good time that we lost track of time — it's already midnight, so I'd better make a move.
alt: Time flew while we were chatting — it's midnight already, I should head home.
point: 补 we/it；‘不知不觉’ 说 lose track of time

zh: 工资还没到账，这周先帮我垫一下，下周还你。
en: My pay hasn't come in yet. Could you cover me this week? I'll pay you back next week.
alt: I haven't been paid yet — could you lend me some money this week? I'll give it back next week.
point: ‘先帮我垫一下’ 补 you，用 cover me；‘还你’ 补 I'll

zh: 算了一下，每个月扣掉房租和生活费，剩不下多少，得重新做个预算。
en: I've crunched the numbers, and after rent and living costs there's not much left each month, so we need to redo our budget.
alt: Once the rent and bills come out each month there's hardly anything left — we'll have to rework the budget.
point: ‘算了一下’ 补 I've；‘剩不下多少’ 用 there's not much left
